subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 4: /u/ (sun, bun, hug, bug); segmenting and blending; differentiates u and g; rhyming words

show.line: Listen. u, u, up. u, u, sun! Sun has the u sound.

rounds.prompt: Which word has the u sound? Bun, bin.
Say the sound with me. u, as in up!
Listen. h, u, g. What word is it?
Listen. b, u, g. What word is it?

hints: Open your mouth a little and say u. u, u, up.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that rhymes with sun.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Sit does not rhyme with sun. Bun rhymes with sun.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Sun, bun. Same at the end!

parent_line: Can hear the u sound and blend words like sun, hug and bug.
